<nowiki />
|translation='''Title:''' Victory before one's eyes.

'''Card text:''' If Tarkin is defending a battle alone, draw and add two battle destiny. If an alien, rather than Tarkin, is defending a battle alone, draw and add one battle destiny.

'''Lore:''' Grand Moff Tarkin, a ruthless ruler of the Outer Rim, destroyed Alderaan with the Death Star and established rule by fear.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese card explicitly says to draw the added battle destiny and describes the alien alternative as an alien rather than Tarkin. The English printing says to add battle destiny in either case.
|notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Moment Of Triumph]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].
